text:
[NDBG.13.1.1] When the session is paused, `scopes` on the focused
thread's top frame returns five scopes:

| Scope | Contents |
|---|---|
| `Bindings` | The firing's bound variables, by their source names — one entry per LHS pattern binding |
| `Working Memory` | The facts at the current position, grouped by schema, paged 100 to a schema |
| `Agenda` | In replay, the firings still to come in this pump, in order; empty in a live session |
| `Cache` | Each cache key at the current position, with its value and its TTL |
| `Calls` | The calls waiting for an answer, then those answered in this pump |
